title: 乒乓球赛圆满落幕！
title_en: The Table Tennis Tournament Has Concluded!
excerpt: 武汉外国语学校2025-2026学年度乒乓球赛圆满落幕，结果如下：（点击查看详情）
excerpt_en: The 2025–2026 school-year table tennis tournament at WFLS has concluded. Results below (click for details):
content:
单打冠军：任峻贤
单打亚军：付大卫
单打季军：谷子易
单打季军：梅哲宇

团体赛冠军：魏罗瑞、陈瑜萱、王成悦、王南烨、周瑞涵
团体赛冠军：祁子傲、李南熠、丁瑞、张书行
团体赛亚军：梅哲宇、龚雨煊、王天森、彭一和
团体赛季军：张宸瑞、陈项诚、任峻贤、岳镇淳、付大卫

感谢每一位参赛选手的奋力拼搏和场边观众的激情助威。从小组赛到淘汰赛，每一记挥拍都展现了我们社团的风采。
祝贺获奖的同学们，也感谢所有工作人员的付出。球不落地，永不放弃，让我们带着这份热爱，继续进步！

颁奖仪式将在学校代购的奖杯和奖牌到货后举行（政教处说预计还要一周），届时会在社群通知时间与地点，敬请期待d(^_^o)
content_en:
Singles Champion: REN Junxian
Singles Runner-up: FU Dawei
Singles Bronze: GU Ziyi
Singles Bronze: MEI Zheyu

Team Event Champions: WEI Luorui, CHEN Yuxuan, WANG Chengyue, WANG Nanye, ZHOU Ruihan
Team Event Champions: QI Ziao, LI Nanyi, DING Rui, ZHANG Shuxing
Team Event Runners-up: MEI Zheyu, GONG Yuxuan, WANG Tiansen, PENG Yihe
Team Event Bronze: ZHANG Chenrui, CHEN Xiangcheng, REN Junxian, YUE Zhenchun, FU Dawei

Thank you to every player for their fighting spirit, and to every spectator on the sidelines for their loud support. From the group stage to the knockout rounds, every swing of the paddle showed the character of our club.
Congratulations to the winners, and thanks to all the officials for their work. The ball never falls, we never give up — let us carry this passion forward and keep improving!

The award ceremony will be held once the trophies and medals ordered through the school have arrived (the student affairs office says it will take about another week). The time and place will be announced in the group chat — stay tuned! d(^_^o)
